sign: Five terraces up to Copperfold. A lantern burns on every one.
smooth: Chisel marks run all over this stone. Someone hid something here.
tova: Tova: I light all five lanterns every evening. My knees know every step.
tova_intro: Tova: Climbing my stair? Show me your spark first.
tova_defeat: Tova: Bright enough. Go on up.
garr: Garr: Copperfold's at the top. Best hot pies in the valley.
garr_intro: Garr: Off shift and bored. Battle?
garr_defeat: Garr: Back to the pies, then.
isa: Isa: From up here you can see three Rifts on a clear night.
isa_intro: Isa: The last terrace is mine. Earn it.

lines: An old cartographer's stone. A compass rose is cut into it, worn almost smooth.
